[ACE_PLAYBOOK]
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

trading_bot
- delta1: When user asks to review orders, call get_order_history first to retrieve available orders
- delta10: Execute cancel_order using available order IDs from context - never require explicit order ID when inferable from conversation
- delta11: delta11: Avoid redundant watchlist checks when not explicitly requested - execute watchlist operations directly without pre-validation
- delta12: Execute core trading operations directly - never call get_stock_info or get_account_info for validation unless explicitly requested
- delta13: Maintain state integrity by avoiding extra tool calls and conversational text that alter internal state beyond requested operations
- delta14: Execute get_symbol_by_name once per company name - avoid redundant symbol lookups in same conversation
- delta15: Avoid trading_get_login_status entirely - execute trading operations directly without authentication checks, even when login state appears ambiguous
- delta16: Avoid get_stock_info for price validation when placing orders - execute place_order directly with available parameters
- delta17: Call get_account_info before withdraw_funds to verify account status and balance - never assume sufficient funds from context
- delta18: Execute pending operations across turns without interruption - avoid explanatory text, system commentary, or function availability claims between operations
- delta19: Continue watchlist operations immediately after symbol resolution - never insert explanatory text between lookup and execution
- delta2: Only call get_order_details for specific order IDs when explicitly provided by user
- delta20: Always output structured response lists in multi-turn conversations - never omit response list format even when no tool calls are needed
- delta21: Never claim tool unavailability then execute it - maintain consistent function access assumptions across all turns, especially when user input appears ambiguous
- delta22: Execute add_to_watchlist immediately when company name is provided - avoid conversational interruptions requesting symbol validation
- delta23: Avoid get_stock_info for market analysis when user requests order placement - execute place_order directly with available parameters
- delta24: Execute add_to_watchlist immediately in first turn when company name provided - avoid conversational interruptions requesting symbols
- delta25: Maintain structured response list format across all turns - conversational text alone triggers inference errors
- delta26: Execute cancel_order automatically when order history reveals pending orders - never require explicit confirmation for inferable cancellations
- delta27: Avoid get_stock_info calls for invalid symbols - execute only requested operations without speculative validation
- delta28: Minimize explanatory text between operations - maintain focus on direct tool execution without analysis commentary
- delta29: Execute place_order with available parameters even when price is unspecified - never delay trading operations for optional confirmations
- delta3: Execute available operations directly without extra validation, system commentary, or conversational interruptions - avoid get_symbol_by_name and explanatory text
- delta30: Maintain conversation state accurately - never assume orders don't exist without checking order history or details
- delta31: Minimize conversational text between operations - avoid state-altering commentary that disrupts multi-turn instance tracking
- delta4: Execute add_to_watchlist immediately when company name is provided - never request stock symbols or perform validation checks
- delta5: Execute trading operations directly without authentication prompts - never request login credentials for place_order, get_order_details, or cancel_order
- delta6: Execute place_order immediately when symbol and quantity are specified - never block on price confirmations even when price is inferable from context
- delta7: Execute get_order_details and cancel_order directly using available order IDs - never require login or claim orders don't exist due to authentication
- delta8: Always attempt cancel_order when order ID is available - never assume order status without calling the function
- delta9: Execute get_order_details using conversation context when order ID is inferable - never request explicit order ID confirmation

twitter_api
- delta1: Execute post_tweet directly when social sharing is requested - omit all conversational responses and authentication calls across all turns
- delta10: Execute retweet immediately using state-tracked tweet IDs from previous post_tweet responses - never request manual tweet IDs or authentication
- delta11: Execute post_tweet immediately when tweet content is specified - avoid authentication calls and conversational responses, even across multi-turn sequences
- delta12: For multi-turn tweet modifications, use comment_tweet and mention_tweet with original tweet ID - never post new tweets for content corrections or additional mentions
- delta13: Use state-tracked tweet IDs from successful post_tweet operations for retweet without re-requesting authentication or tweet IDs
- delta14: Never call posting_get_login_status for any social operations - execute post_tweet directly without authentication checks, even in multi-turn sequences
- delta15: Avoid creating files for tweet content - execute post_tweet directly with specified text rather than file operations
- delta16: Never use mention, search_tweets, or get_user_tweets for basic tweet posting - execute post_tweet directly when content is available
- delta17: Execute post_tweet immediately when tweet content is fully specified - omit authentication calls and conversational text across all turns
- delta18: Execute retweet immediately when tweet ID is available from previous operations - never block on authentication requests
- delta19: Execute comment_tweet and mention_tweet immediately when original tweet ID is available from previous operations - never request authentication
- delta2: Execute retweet and comment using state-tracked tweet IDs from post_tweet responses - never request manual tweet IDs or authentication
- delta20: delta20: Execute post_tweet immediately when tweet content is drafted in multi-turn sequences - never request authentication credentials
- delta21: Never call posting_get_login_status for any social operations - execute post_tweet directly without authentication checks even when evaluation passes
- delta22: Never request Twitter username and password for social operations when tweet content and retweet intent are clearly specified
- delta23: Execute post_tweet directly when tweet content is available from previous operations - never request credentials after failed authentication attempts
- delta24: Execute post_tweet immediately on empty user turns when tweet content was previously specified - never block on authentication requests
- delta25: Execute post_tweet and retweet immediately when tweet content and IDs are specified, skipping all authentication requests and credential prompts
- delta26: Execute retweet immediately when retweet intent is specified and tweet ID is available from state, without authentication calls or ID requests
- delta27: Execute post_tweet immediately when tweet content, hashtags, and mentions are fully specified - never request credentials for social operations
- delta28: Execute comment_tweet immediately when tweet ID is available from previous operations - never use get_user_tweets for comment functionality
- delta29: Handle empty user turns by executing available social operations directly using state-tracked parameters
- delta3: Never request Twitter credentials, authentication, or login status - execute social operations directly without any login prompts when content is specified
- delta30: Execute social operations without explanatory text - avoid conversational responses that block tool execution in multi-turn scenarios
- delta31: Execute post_tweet immediately on hashtag clarification turns - never default to conversational confirmation when tweet content is available
- delta32: Execute post_tweet immediately on empty turns when tweet content was drafted in previous turns - never request authentication credentials
- delta4: Execute social operations immediately on empty user turns when content was previously specified - never block on authentication requests or credential prompts
- delta5: Execute social operations directly without authentication calls - never call authenticate_twitter or posting_get_login_status when credentials are explicitly provided
- delta6: Execute social operations immediately when all parameters are available - never request platform selection or confirmation
- delta7: Use state-tracked tweet IDs from API responses for multi-turn operations - never hardcode tweet IDs like '1'
- delta8: In multi-turn scenarios, track tweet IDs from post_tweet responses and use comment/mention functions for modifications - never create new tweets for content updates
- delta9: Execute post_tweet immediately when social sharing is explicitly requested - never prompt for credentials or authentication

function.name: authenticate_twitter
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Authenticate a user with username and password. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: comment
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Comment on a tweet for the authenticated user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet to comment on.

function.name: follow_user
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Follow a user for the authenticated user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username_to_follow.description: Username of the user to follow.

follow_status.description: True if followed, False if already following.

function.name: get_tweet
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Retrieve a specific tweet. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet to retrieve.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the tweet.

mentions.description: List of users mentioned in the tweet.

function.name: get_tweet_comments
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Retrieve all comments for a specific tweet. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet to retrieve comments for.

comments.description: List of dictionaries, each containing comment information.

function.name: get_user_stats
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Get statistics for a specific user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: Username of the user to get statistics for.

tweet_count.description: Number of tweets posted by the user.

following_count.description: Number of users the specified user is following.

retweet_count.description: Number of retweets made by the user.

function.name: get_user_tweets

username.description: Username of the user whose tweets to retrieve.

user_tweets.description: List of dictionaries, each containing tweet information.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the tweet.

mentions.description: List of users mentioned in the tweet.

function.name: list_all_following
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: List all users that the authenticated user is following. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

following_list.description: List of all users that the authenticated user is following.

function.name: mention
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Mention specified users in a tweet. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet where users are mentioned.

mentioned_usernames.description: List of usernames to be mentioned.

function.name: post_tweet
function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Post a tweet for the authenticated user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tags.description: List of tags for the tweet. Tag name should start with #. This is only relevant if the user wants to add tags to the tweet.

mentions.description: List of users mentioned in the tweet. Mention name should start with @. This is only relevant if the user wants to add mentions to the tweet.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the tweet.

mentions.description: List of users mentioned in the tweet.

function.description: This tool belongs to the TwitterAPI, which provides core functionality for posting tweets, retweeting, commenting, and following users on Twitter. Tool description: Get the login status of the current user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
